descripcion: Promotion rules and revisit cadence that drive vault evolution. The scan tool evaluates these read-only and proposes candidates; nothing is applied automatically.

reglas.descripcion: An owner criterion (K1) becomes an explicit criterion when at least two distinct captured sources support it with episodes.
reglas.condicion: at least two capture notes mention a criterion together with an episode marker (event, job, decision, ceremony)
reglas.accion_propuesta: propose explicit criterion in the matching D/X, owner-confirmed
reglas.no_aplicar_si: single anecdote, unverified figure, or a criterion the owner never stated

reglas.descripcion: An offer line that appears in at least two distinct quotes or proposals deserves its own living record.
reglas.condicion: at least two capture notes contain price or quote markers for the same service line
reglas.accion_propuesta: propose an X01 living offer record
reglas.no_aplicar_si: one-off historical job with no current activity

reglas.descripcion: A direction choice that has a decider and a date is a decision record.
reglas.condicion: a capture note contains a decision marker and a date token, or an agreement/contract marker
reglas.evidencia_requerida: decider plus date (or a written agreement)
reglas.no_aplicar_si: a stated intention with no decider or date

reglas.descripcion: An event that has sale, costs and collected amounts all present is ready for a per-event financial analysis.
reglas.condicion: a capture note contains price markers together with cost markers and payment/balance markers
reglas.accion_propuesta: propose a D05 case analysis with the real result
reglas.no_aplicar_si: partial figures, or a case still open with pending amounts

reglas.descripcion: A segment or channel that shows up across at least three distinct jobs is a real market position.
reglas.condicion: at least three capture notes describe distinct jobs or events through the same segment or channel
reglas.accion_propuesta: propose a D02 segment record with episodes
reglas.no_aplicar_si: single mention or a channel the owner never confirmed

reglas.descripcion: A timing rule for suppliers or purchases that repeats across events becomes an operational rule.
reglas.condicion: at least two capture notes mention supplier or purchase timing (when things must be ordered)
reglas.accion_propuesta: propose a D04 working rule with its episode
reglas.no_aplicar_si: a one-time timing detail with no observed repetition

business_model.sugerencia: run the business-model template round or review D01 revisions

market_customers.sugerencia: run the market template round or review D02 revisions

offer_commercial.sugerencia: run the offer template round or review D03 revisions

execution_processes.sugerencia: run the execution template round or review D04 revisions

economy_finance.sugerencia: run the economy template round or review the last closed event

people_roles.sugerencia: run the people template round after any hire or departure

direction_decisions.sugerencia: run the direction template round after each strategic decision
